text:
amelia: quick sync — customer X is asking for a reserved pool onboarding that includes an exception to standard billing for their pilot. they want headroom + burst for 3 months, but legal pushback on long-term commit. what are the non-negotiables?
mike: for pilots we usually do a time-limited discounted overlay (credits) rather than change the contract. non-negotiable: SLA tier and preemption behavior must be explicit.
jon: agree. also need a cap on burst spillover to shared pools or we blow tail latency for other tenants. propose: soft spill with throttled fallback + alerts.
amelia: customer specifically asked for guaranteed burst up to 2x baseline for first 30 days and a rollback clause. can we support 2x without dedicated extra GPUs?
kiran: technically yes if we prewarm and reserve some ephemeral headroom but that eats into other customers. ops asks for a compensation model: either billed as surge credits or require a short commitment.
mike: proposal: pilot package = 30d guaranteed min baseline (locked), up to 2x burst best-effort with surge credits billed only when we actually consume extra reserved capacity. after 30d, convert to regular reserved pool or sunset pilot.
amelia: legal wants the wording on "guaranteed" — better to call it "guaranteed baseline + managed burst band" and specify that managed burst can be throttled for platform safety.
jon: plus technical launch criteria: 1) replication of their peak prompt mix in staging, 2) KV cache warmup test, 3) prewarm playbook and runbook for ops, 4) observability dashboards hooked to tenant-level traces.
kiran: add billing triggers: clear thresholds when surge credits start, and a refund path if we miss contractual latency SLOs due to our error. ops: will we need a temporary autoscale policy override?
mike: yes — create a pilot autoscale policy called pilot-ephemeral-headroom that allows burst up to X tokens/sec for 30d; includes automatic drain on sustained >48h consumption and alert to SE + ops.
amelia: who owns the customer comms? we need explicit launch checklist to share with them: technical prerequisites, SLOs, billing terms, upgrade path.
jon: i'll own the checklist and staging validation tests. i'll ping infra for quota reservations.
kiran: ops will draft the short-term autoscale override and the surge billing metric. ops also wants a rollback window (first 72 hours) if latency regressions >5%.
amelia: decision points for product: A) approve pilot package with surge-credit billing? B) approve temporary autoscale override? C) gating criteria for GA conversion?
mike: product thumbs-up on A + B if ops drafts the override and we add the rollback SLO. For C, GA conversion requires 2 customer pilots or 90 days with <1% SLO regressions.
jon: noted. next steps: 1) ops (kiran) to post policy draft by EOD tomorrow, 2) jon to share staging validation checklist, 3) amelia to confirm legal wording. i'll set a short meeting if any of those slip.
deploy-bot: reminder — quota reservation request queued (req-789) will be processed 04:00 UTC tomorrow, watch for failures in #eng-infra.
amelia: thanks — if everyone is aligned i'll draft the pilot one-pager for the customer with the managed burst language and surge-credit table.
mike: sounds good. :thumbsup:
